page.overview:
What is Rose?

Rose, previously named Three, is one of the main deuteragonists and true main antagonists in Bobbiedots, Part 1 and Bobbiedots, Part 2 in the fourth and fifth books from the Tales from the Pizzaplex series.

Rose is one of the second-generation (also known as gen2) Bobbiedots in the Fazplex Tower. In Abe's apartment, she is the diet and lifestyle Bobbiedot.

Rose is a bright-faced holographic girl with long, hot-pink pigtails that look like streams of light rather than actual hair. She wears a white-and-gray bell-bottomed bodysuit striped with the same hot pink. Rose has a large heart-shaped face with unnaturally huge, hot-pink, catlike eyes. Her arched brows are the same pink as her hair, as is a large oval spot on her forehead and a large circle on top of her head. Rose’s bow-shaped mouth, which is under a small protrusion that is her nose, is the same color. Her pigtails are topped by hot-pink-and-gray bows. Rose has a gray skin, a round belly, and rounded shoulders. The bottom of her shoes glimmer as bright pink as her eyes.

Rose has an upbeat personality, with her always talking in a high pitched voice, similar to that of a "perky cheerleader". She is sometimes doing kawaii and cutesy poses around Abe. However, she also shows that she does eat a lot, much to the annoyance of Gemini and Olive.
